title: Branchloom global settings
description: Global Branchloom configuration. Project-specific settings are stored separately in projects.json.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used to provide editor validation and completion.

agents.description: Agent commands available when creating and opening sessions.

reviewPrompt.description: Prompt template used when starting a pull request review.

theme.description: Application color theme. System follows the operating system preference.

tools.description: External tools used for opening files and directories.

worktreeTemplate.description: Template for new worktree paths. Supports {projectName}, {projectPath}, {sessionName}, {sessionSlug}, and {worktreePath}.

agentContextPath.description: Optional path to shared context supplied to agent sessions.

pullRequestFilters.description: Saved filters used to select pull requests in the pull request views.

jiraEndpoint.description: Base URL of the Jira instance. Authentication uses the JIRA_TOKEN environment variable.

boards.description: Named kanban boards and the sources, columns, and rules shown on each board.

projectGroups.description: Names of project groups used to organize projects in the project tree.

agent.description: An agent executable and the commands used to create or open a session.

newSessionCommand.description: Command used to start a new agent session. Supports {prompt}.

openCommand.description: Command used to open an existing agent session. Supports {prompt}.

tool.description: An external editor or other file-opening tool.

command.description: Executable command used to open a file.

query.description: Query used to select pull requests.

config.description: Columns and source configuration for the board.

boardConfig.description: Board columns and enabled item sources.

columns.description: Columns displayed from left to right.

sources.description: Sources that provide items for the board.

boardColumn.description: A board column and the source values that place items in it.

rules.description: Source-specific value mappings used to place items in this column.

PULL_REQUEST.description: Pull request state value for this column.

GITHUB_ISSUES.description: GitHub issue state value for this column.

JIRA.description: Jira issue JEXL rule. Jira exposes status, author, assignee, title, description, dates, and identifiers.

AGENT_SESSION.description: Agent session state value for this column.

sourceConfigs.description: Configuration for each board item source.

AGENT_SESSION_CONFIG.description: Enables or disables agent session items.

enabled.description: Whether agent session items are included.

querySourceConfig.description: Enables a source and optionally filters its items by query.

enabled.description: Whether items from this source are included.

query.description: Source-specific query used to select items.
